objective: Independently certify Road LTL Operational Knowledge + Canonical Information hardening before any R0.4 authorization.

ci.note: CI success is accepted as implementation/test evidence but does not override independent semantic QA.

qaFinding.statement: The R0.3 COMPOSED coverage surface is not the complete governed effective Road LTL 1.5 module surface. The implementation composes data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json with the v1.4/v1.5 Operational Knowledge payloads, but omits the governed data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json module overlay from semantic composition. R0.2 already certified effective Road LTL 1.5 as the lossless materialization of the v1.4 module base plus the v1.5 module overlay, with 21 inherited tasks and LTL-03 as the single direct module override.
evidence: data/road-ltl/effective-road-ltl-1.5-materialization.json declares effectiveModuleVersion 1.5, semanticBaseVersion 1.4, base data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json, overlay data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json, 21 inherited tasks and 1 LTL-03 direct governed override.
data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json contains the governed LTL-03 module override and materializationPolicy LOSSLESS_INHERIT_BASE_THEN_APPLY_OVERRIDES.

governance/recovery/R0.3/POST_IMPLEMENTATION_PRE_QA.json defines COMPOSED layers as data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json plus the v1.4/v1.5 Operational Knowledge payloads, excluding data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json from the composed layer despite listing it as a governed input.

governance/recovery/R0.3/OK_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json marks LTL-03 version as SATISFIED_BY_DECLARED_EQUIVALENT from moduleRoot module.version on the v1.4 module while simultaneously identifying LTL-03 as a DIRECT_GOVERNED_1_5_OVERRIDE.
qaFinding.materialEffect: Coverage counts and equivalence classifications for LTL-03 are not certifiable until the effective v1.5 module semantics are included. At minimum the version equivalence is internally inconsistent, and the v1.5 module overlay contains additional governed LTL-03 semantics that may alter coverage classification.
requiredRemediation: Use the R0.2-certified effective Road LTL 1.5 module materialization as the module semantic surface, or deterministically compose data/modules/road-ltl-v1.4.json with data/modules/road-ltl-v1.5.json under its governed materialization policy before Operational Knowledge coverage assessment.
Re-evaluate LTL-03 across all 24 Operational Knowledge Contract v2 attributes against the effective module plus effective Operational Knowledge surface.
Do not count task version as satisfied from the v1.4 module root for LTL-03. Define and test the governed version-resolution rule explicitly.
Regenerate all five R0.3 artifacts, hashes, semantic hashes and Checkpoint-B results after remediation.
Extend regression tests so deliberately removing the v1.5 module overlay from composition fails closed.
Preserve PRE_CHANGE_BASELINE.json and the current candidate/CI history; remediation must supersede, not rewrite, the failed-QA evidence.

additionalBlockingCustodyFinding.statement: Checkpoint B candidate evidence has not yet been mirrored to Google Drive. The implementation records the connector result 'No approval received'. The standing custody standard requires candidate/evidence mirroring at Checkpoint B and final governance/evidence mirroring at Checkpoint C before COMPLETE.
requiredRemediation: Mirror the remediated Checkpoint-B evidence package to the governed Drive recovery location as CANDIDATE / AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_QA.
After QA PASS, mirror the final Checkpoint-C package and verify GitHub/Drive agreement.

notes: R0.3 is not closed. Independent QA found one blocking semantic-composition defect and one blocking custody gap. Architecture refinement remains deliberately behind R0.3 closure, per Owner direction.
